title: Upgrade Desk Rule Note on Live Registrations Held by One Customer
content:
Under the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes each programme caps how many live upgrade credits one customer may hold under it at once, and a credit counts as live while the registration stands at registered, appraisal pending, credit issued or partially redeemed. The most live registrations the policy contemplates for any one customer is four (4); each programme's own cap for one customer is the figure it publishes for live credits held at once, and none of those published figures exceeds four.

## The rule on a further registration

A further registration is opened for a customer only when no registration already recorded against the same credit reference stands at registered, appraisal pending, credit issued or partially redeemed. A registration that has been fully spent, has expired or has been revoked no longer counts, so the customer may register another piece once one of theirs closes.

The test is made on the system's own records before the registration is opened: what counts is the standing of the registrations already recorded against that credit reference, and two registrations are told apart by the date each was registered and the programme each runs under.

## Which standings count as live

| Standing of the registration | Counts as a live credit |
|---|---|
| registered | yes |
| appraisal pending | yes |
| credit issued | yes |
| partially redeemed | yes |
| redeemed (fully spent) | no |
| expired | no |
| revoked | no |

The count is taken as at the handling date, with no look-back: a registration that closed yesterday is not live today.

## Cases

- A customer holds one registration at credit issued and one that expired last month. The expired one does not count; the customer holds one live credit.
- A registration already recorded against a credit reference stands at appraisal pending. No further registration is opened against that reference while it stands there.
- The same registration later closes as redeemed. A further registration may then be opened against the reference, subject to the programme's cap on live credits held at once.
